objects.name: Lottery redirect names on a shared delivery network: technical analysis
objects.description: Two address blocks on two different networks answer for the same 319 throwaway names, and the names open Chinese-language lottery and betting pages. NSS recorded 100 of those names itself, a median of 21 minutes after their certificates appeared, and none of the 100 is on any list NSS holds. This paper sets out what ties the names together, why the two blocks are a shared delivery network and not one operator's servers, and what a defender can look for.
